info.name: Microsoft Azure Moves Resources From One Resource Group To Another Resource Group

params.name: sourceResourceGroupName
params.description: The name of the resource group from the source subscription containing the resources to be moved.

params.name: api-version
params.description: The API version to use for this operation.

params.name: subscriptionId
params.description: The Microsoft Azure subscription ID.

items.docs: The resources to be moved must be in the same source resource group in the source subscription being used. The target resource group may be in a different subscription. When moving resources, both the source group and the target group are locked for the duration of the operation. Write and delete operations are blocked on the groups until the move completes.

info.name: Microsoft Azure Validates Whether Resources Can Be Moved From One Resource Group To Another Resource Group

params.name: sourceResourceGroupName
params.description: The name of the resource group from the source subscription containing the resources to be validated for move.

params.name: api-version
params.description: The API version to use for this operation.

params.name: subscriptionId
params.description: The Microsoft Azure subscription ID.

items.docs: This operation checks whether the specified resources can be moved to the target. The resources to be moved must be in the same source resource group in the source subscription being used. The target resource group may be in a different subscription. If validation succeeds, it returns HTTP response code 204 (no content). If validation fails, it returns HTTP response code 409 (Conflict) with an error message. Retrieve the URL in the Location header value to check the result of the long-running op
